twoYearArc.title: Two years, from watching to deciding

semesters.title: Foundation and first diagnoses
semesters.desc: Through cases, classroom interactions, and field visits, watch practitioners make decisions.

semesters.title: Cross-functional integration
semesters.desc: Start doing cross-functional projects. Present diagnoses to mixed juries of faculty and sector practitioners

semesters.title: 8 to 10 week internship
semesters.desc: A problem brief from a real company. You work under joint guidance of a faculty mentor and an industry mentor.

semesters.title: Sector commitment
semesters.desc: Commit to one or two sectors and job roles.

semesters.title: Capstone
semesters.desc: Electives + possibility of a long-term industry engagement and a Pre-Placement Offer.
